verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API and an API overview page, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples. Probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The CLI's raw API access and the MCP server are separate capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
